description: Generate presentations, documents, websites, and social posts programmatically.

tools.name: folders_list
tools.description: List folders the authenticated user can access. Use returned id values in folderIds in generation requests. Cursor-paginated with hasMore and nextCursor fields. Optional: query, limit, after. Returns array of FolderItem.

params.name: query
params.description: Filter folders by name

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum results per page (1-50, default 20)

params.name: after
params.description: Cursor from previous response nextCursor for pagination

tools.name: gammas_delete
tools.description: Delete a Gamma permanently. Requires workspace admin role. Auto-archives first if needed. Gamma becomes immediately inaccessible. gammaId must be the API file ID (g_... prefix), not the URL slug. Required: gammaId. Returns the DeleteGammaResponse. Destructive.

params.name: gammaId
params.description: The API file ID of the Gamma to delete (g_... prefix)

tools.name: gammas_archive_gamma
tools.description: Archive a Gamma to remove it from active workspace without deleting. Idempotent: archiving an already-archived Gamma returns 200. gammaId must be the API file ID (g_... prefix from generation poll response), NOT the URL slug. Passing a URL slug returns 403. Required: gammaId.

params.name: gammaId
params.description: The API file ID of the Gamma to archive (g_... prefix, from completed generation poll)

tools.name: generations_create
tools.description: Start an asynchronous generation from text. Returns generationId immediately. Poll GET /v1.0/generations/{id} every 5 seconds until status is completed or failed. Generation typically takes 1-3 minutes. Credits charged on completion. Required: inputText. Optional: additionalInstructions, cardOptions, cardSplit (plus 10 more).

params.name: additionalInstructions
params.description: Additional instructions for the AI

params.name: card-options-dimensions
params.description: Card aspect ratio/dimensions

params.name: card-options-header-footer-hide-from-first-card
params.description: Hide header/footer from the first card (title card)

params.name: card-options-header-footer-hide-from-last-card
params.description: Hide header/footer from the last card

params.name: cardSplit
params.description: How to split content across cards

params.name: exportAs
params.description: Export format for automatic export after generation. png = .zip with one PNG per card.

params.name: folderIds
params.description: Folder IDs to place the generated Gamma in (from GET /folders)

params.name: format
params.description: Output format for the generated Gamma

params.name: image-options-model
params.description: AI model to use for image generation

params.name: image-options-source
params.description: Source for images

params.name: image-options-style
params.description: Style description for AI-generated images

params.name: inputText
params.description: The text content to generate from (topic, outline, or full content)

params.name: numCards
params.description: Target number of cards/slides to generate (1-75 depending on plan)

params.name: sharing-options-email-options-access
params.description: Permission level for email recipients

params.name: sharing-options-email-options-recipients
params.description: Email addresses to share with

params.name: sharing-options-external-access
params.description: Access level for external users via shared link

params.name: sharing-options-workspace-access
params.description: Default access level for workspace members

params.name: textMode
params.description: How to interpret the input text

params.name: text-options-amount
params.description: Controls the amount of text generated per card

params.name: text-options-audience
params.description: The target audience for the content

params.name: text-options-language
params.description: Language code for the generated content

params.name: text-options-tone
params.description: The tone or writing style for the generated text

params.name: themeId
params.description: Theme ID to apply (from GET /themes)

params.name: title
params.description: Custom title. Auto-generated if not provided.

tools.name: generations_create-from-template
tools.description: Adapt an existing Gamma by providing the template file ID and instructions. Template structure preserved by default. gammaId must be the API file ID (g_... prefix), not the URL slug. Required: gammaId, prompt. Optional: exportAs, folderIds, imageOptions (plus 3 more). Returns the new FromTemplateGenerationResponse.

params.name: exportAs
params.description: Export format for automatic export after generation

params.name: folderIds
params.description: Folder IDs to place the generated Gamma in

params.name: gammaId
params.description: File ID of the Gamma to use as template (g_... prefix). NOT the URL slug.

params.name: image-options-model
params.description: AI model to use for image generation

params.name: image-options-style
params.description: Style description for images

params.name: prompt
params.description: Instructions describing what to change in the template

params.name: sharing-options-email-options-access
params.description: Permission level for email recipients

params.name: sharing-options-email-options-recipients
params.description: Email addresses to share with

params.name: sharing-options-external-access
params.description: Access level for external users via shared link

params.name: sharing-options-workspace-access
params.description: Default access level for workspace members

params.name: themeId
params.description: Theme ID to apply (from GET /themes)

params.name: title
params.description: Custom title for the generated Gamma

tools.name: generations_get-status
tools.description: Poll this endpoint until status is completed or failed. On completion returns gammaId (g_... prefix), gammaUrl, exportUrl (if exportAs was set, expires approx 1 week), and credits. PNG exports are a .zip with one PNG per card. Required: id.

params.name: id
params.description: The generationId returned from the create endpoint

tools.name: themes_list
tools.description: List themes available in the authenticated workspace. Use returned id as themeId in generation requests. Cursor-paginated with hasMore and nextCursor fields. Optional: query, limit, after (plus 1 more). Returns array of ThemeItem.

params.name: query
params.description: Filter themes by name

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum results per page (1-50, default 20)

params.name: after
params.description: Cursor from previous response nextCursor for pagination

params.name: type
params.description: Filter by theme type: standard for built-in, custom for workspace themes
